key_stat: Eurozone's largest bank by assets | AXA IM acquired
summary: BNP Paribas is the Eurozone's largest bank, operating across retail (France, Belgium, Italy), CIB, investment solutions, and insurance. AssetFoundry tokenization platform tested on public Ethereum (Feb 2026). Canton Network member. Digital Asset $135M investment. AXA IM acquisition adds investment innovation. Eurosystem CBDC experiments. Strategy: European market leadership, MiCA positioning, sustainable finance, integrated group model (AM + Securities Services + CIB).
